python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import subprocess, zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as E
import music21 as m, converter21
converter21.register()
for p in sorted(Path('inputs/images').glob('*.png')):
 print('\nIMAGE',p,Image.open(p).size)
 for mode in ['6','11']:
  r=subprocess.run(['tesseract',str(p),'stdout','--psm',mode],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print('OCR',mode,r.stdout)
for p in sorted(Path('inputs/baselines/audiveris-enlarged').glob('*raw.mxl')):
 z=zipfile.ZipFile(p); n=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml') and not n.startswith('META')][0]; root=E.fromstring(z.read(n))
 print('\nXML',p.name)
 for meas in root.findall('.//part/measure'):
  print('MEASURE',meas.get('number'),E.tostring(meas,encoding='unicode')[:5500])
